title: Face Tracker
description: Draws tracked face contours, adjustable landmark nodes and per-point motion trails over a selectable colour or the analyzed image, without identity recognition.

parameters.label: Background Image
parameters.description: Visibility of the analyzed image behind the tracker.

parameters.label: Background Colour
parameters.description: Background colour used when the analyzed image is hidden.

parameters.label: Tracked Points
parameters.description: Number of visible facial landmark nodes and per-point trails.

parameters.label: Glow
parameters.description: Soft glow around the tracked structure.
